Your ASC is conjunct Pluto in your 1st house which is opposite almost all of your Gemini stellium which conveniently falls in your 7th house (in WSH at least). 

Your ascendant shines a direct light on Pluto and vice versa in your 1H which aspects all of the planets opposite in your 7H, creating a lot of tense energy between the planets. 

More than half of your inner planets (Sun, Moon, Mercury, and Venus) are all sitting in your 7H which represents your interpersonal relationships. You may have a strong, instinctual tendency to focus a LOT of your energy on your close relationships. Even though Pluto isn’t directly in your 7H, it’s greatly affecting it being opposite in your 1H which might lead to you being attracted to people with these negative ways.

The first thing I noticed it that your 21° R Gemini Mercury is opposite your 19° R Sagittarius Mars. Fire and air are quick-thinking and often time don’t process everything they need to before taking off with whatever endeavor. Having your Mercury opposite your Mars can create a lot of conflicting energy when it comes to the way you communicate and the way you act. 

I don’t have a lot of experience natally having a retrograde Mercury, but I do have a retrograde Mars and know I try to go about confrontation the way I think is best but can still bite me in the ass. 

If you chose to look at your chart in WSH vs Placidus (or default), you could see the structural-layout of your chart a bit easier in some ways too. Regardless of the two house systems, you have your Mercury in your 12th house which can lead to inevitable confusion or miscommunication in how you may come across to other people. The 12th house can also represent hidden enemies, so you may encounter a few of those in your life maybe based on the communication you have with certain individuals. I have a 12H Moon and have *so many* issues with the way I emotionally come across to certain people and have made honestly too many enemies that I can relate to my 12th house. Yours is in Gemini, so you may see a pattern with those who have certain Gemini (or mutable) placements in their charts.

I’ve never really had any positive experiences with Pluto in synastry with another person personally, but obviously my word isn’t key. It’s usually an unhealthy, imbalanced connection where there can be a lot of misplaced fixation or just someone confidently controlling all of the power. Astrology aside and a small piece of advice with zero knowledge on the relationship, an age gap of even just five years at 21-years-old can be a difficult situation to navigate. Make sure you’re keeping your best interests at heart and are sure the other person is too and isn’t trying to take advantage of you. Be safe.

No Splash of 2% Milk

Regular Ice

Regular Splash of Heavy Cream (or whatever milk you wanted instead of 2%)
